```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../data/midwest_airbnb_extended.db")
listings     = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings") |> tibble::as_tibble()
availability = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "availability_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
reviews      = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "reviews_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
```

## Task 1
```{r task 1}
listings |> 
  dplyr::count(host_id, sort = T) -> host_counts

host_counts |> 
  dplyr::filter(n >= 10) |> 
  dplyr::summarise(hosts = dplyr::n())

listings |> 
  dplyr::left_join(host_counts, by = "host_id") -> listings_hosts

listings_hosts |> 
  dplyr::filter(city == "Chicago") |> 
  dplyr::summarise(pct_big_hosts = mean(n >= 10) * 100)
```


## Task 2
```{r task 2}
listings |> 
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt" & accommodates >= 4 & number_of_reviews >= 10 & review_scores_rating >= 4.8
  ) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(price_per_person = price / accommodates) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city, neighbourhood) |> 
  dplyr::summarise(
    listings = dplyr::n(),
    median_ppp = median(price_per_person)
  ) |> 
  dplyr::filter(listings >= 20 & city == "Columbus") |> 
  dplyr::arrange(median_ppp) -> q3
q3
```


## Task 3
```{r task 3}
listings |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city, room_type) |> 
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(
      c(price, reviews_per_month, estimated_revenue_l365d),
      ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) -> q4
q4
```


## Task 4
```{r task 4}
listings |> 
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(estimated_revenue_l365d)) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    rank = dplyr::row_number(),
    top10 = rank <= ceiling(0.10 * dplyr::n())
  ) |> 
  dplyr::summarise(
    pct_top10 = sum(estimated_revenue_l365d * top10, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  ) -> q5
q5
```


## Task 5
```{r task 5}
availability |> 
  dplyr::filter(month == "2026-10") -> oct

listings |> 
  dplyr::filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |> 
  dplyr::inner_join(oct, by = "id") |> 
  dplyr::mutate(mostly_taken = nights_available < 0.5 * nights_in_month) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city) |> 
  dplyr::summarise(
    listings = dplyr::n(),
    share_taken = mean(mostly_taken)
  ) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(share_taken) -> q6
q6
```


## Task 6
```{r task 6}
listings |> 
  dplyr::filter(city == "Twin Cities") |> 
  dplyr::inner_join(reviews, by = "id") |> 
  dplyr::filter(month >= "2025-07" & month <= "2026-06") |> 
  dplyr::count(month, wt = reviews, sort = T) -> q8
q8

max(q8$n) / min(q8$n)
```


## Task 7
```{r task 7}
listings |> 
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt" & (host_is_superhost == "t" | host_is_superhost == "f")
  ) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city, host_is_superhost) |> 
  dplyr::summarise(
    median_price = median(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_rating = median(review_scores_rating, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) -> b1
b1
```


## Task 8
```{r task 8}
listings |> 
  dplyr::anti_join(availability, by = "id") |> 
  dplyr::count(city, sort = T) -> a10
a10

sum(a10$n)
```
